svg.title: SPACE as a living three-level service chassis
svg.desc: An exploded isometric machine separates the control plane above, node-level security and checkpoint services in the middle, and two isolated Firecracker guests below. A command descends through an external private-channel spine to the guest daemon. The selected guest executes; its request climbs a separate outbound conduit and passes the host gateway. Credentials stay in the host vault. The checkpoint arm then records session state. The 14-second illustrative cycle shows relationships, not measured timing. Reduced motion presents the complete static architecture.
svg.text: Conceptual service chassis · height separates responsibilities, not physical deployment
